neighbours.label: the first piece of a present-tense verb that the tokenizer splits (dep|arts, inv|ades, dev|otes, con|veys), predicting the verb's ending, as against single-token verbs in the same slot

In the second act the army invades the island.

The painting conveys a sense of quiet loss.
The last bus departs from the square at midnight.
She devotes an hour each day to the piano.
His letter conveys warm thanks to all the staff.
In the story a dragon invades the peaceful valley.
